title: task edit --type "" stores an empty string instead of clearing the type (same defect as QCLI-539)
description: Split out of QCLI-539 (PR #691), which fixes the priority half only. resolveVocabularyValue documents an empty value as the clear for both type and priority, but foldEditPatch (src/application/tasks/edit-patch.ts) writes `patch.type` verbatim, so `quest task edit <id> --type ""` stores `"type":""` and quest has no way to remove it. Expected, from the QCLI-539 shape: not reproduced yet against `bun src/cli/main.ts`; reproduce first. Check task create and edit-batch for the same empty-value handling.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A type set on a task can be cleared through quest, so the stored record has no type key and task view reads null
The behavior is stated in task edit help and the changelog, and covered by a set-then-clear test plus the out-of-set-still-refused case
